We promise a fun evening stuffed with entertaining games, quick lines, and wholesome stories.

title: Make Friends with the Stage: Open Stage Jam by Improv Lore
author: amehra4u
excerpt:

full_content:
The Open Stage Jam is where you get to step in and play, and try your hand at doing some improv on stage!
We’ll set up simple scenes and scenarios, guide you, and keep things moving so you’re never left figuring it out on your own. You can jump in for a scene or two, try something new, and step back whenever you like.
It’s a space that’s designed to be easy to enter, and built for taking small risks. You might come in just to watch, but we’re hoping you’ll leave having played.

excerpt: And, Then? brings together some of Improv Lore’s most experienced performers for an evening of unscripted theatre. Whether we’re revisiting a format we love or exploring something entirely new, every performance is buil…
full_content: And, Then? brings together some of Improv Lore’s most experienced performers for an evening of unscripted theatre. Whether we’re revisiting a format we love or exploring something entirely new, every performance is built live with curiosity, collaboration, and a sense of play at its heart.

title: Whimsical Wednesday with Improv Lore
author: amehra4u
full_content:
Dive into the whimsical world of improvisation at our Wednesday Jams!
Whether you’re a novice to theatre, a maverick on stage, or just dipping your toes into the world of unscripted performance, this Jam is designed for everyone. Our facilitators will guide you through a series of engaging improv exercises, help you explore new characters, and set up scenarios that will make your inner wit shine - all on the spot!
Come as you are, leave your inhibitions at the door, and join us on this journey of endless possibility.
Bring a friend, a date, or a group - our brave space is for everyone!

title: PowerPoint Roulette by Improv Lore
author: amehra4u
excerpt: PowerPoint Roulette is a fast-paced, creative show where improvisers deliver presentations from slides they’ve never seen before. Each performer is faced with slides filled with bizarre graphs, meaningless acronyms, and…
full_content:
PowerPoint Roulette is a fast-paced, creative show where improvisers deliver presentations from slides they’ve never seen before. Each performer is faced with slides filled with bizarre graphs, meaningless acronyms, and unexpected themes. With no time to prepare, they must improvise convincing explanations, facts, stories, and insights on the spot.
Serious business pitches, heartfelt eulogies, hard-hitting TED talks, and fanciful conspiracy theories - prepare yourselves for a night ‘official’ fun! The audience gets to join the revelry by asking questions, creating a truly unpredictable night of improvised theatrics.

title: Musical Improv Show by Improv Lore
author: blala_land
full_content:
A regular improv show, but with a lot more singing!
Using your suggestions as inspiration, our performers will build scenes, create characters, and sing songs completely made up on the spot.
Some songs may be heartfelt, some surprisingly catchy, while some may never find their rhyme, but every one of them will be improvised in the moment.
We’re also going to be playing some classic musical improv games, inspired from Whose Line Is It Anyway?, like the Hoedown, and the Irish Drinking Song.
Come, sing along with us in celebration of our budding songwriting talents!

title: Make an Improv Song: Musical Improv Jam by Improv Lore
author: amehra4u
excerpt:
This Musical Improv Jam is a space to ease into singing, rhythm, and making things up with a bit of melody. 
We’ll walk through the basics of finding a beat, building simple rhymes, spotting patterns, and shaping a c…
full_content:
This Musical Improv Jam is a space to ease into singing, rhythm, and making things up with a bit of melody.
We’ll walk through the basics of finding a beat, building simple rhymes, spotting patterns, and shaping a chorus or catchphrase you can come back to. We’ll do just enough to help you feel grounded and willing to try.
Even if you think you can’t sing, come! This session is less about hitting the ‘right’ note and more about jumping in, listening, and letting the music carry you. By the end, you might surprise yourself with what you’re able to create on the spot.
*Our Musical Improv Jam doesn’t have a stage or an audience; there is no performance in this segment.
